Why Now

The category is moving from the shadows into regulated care.

For years this category has run on imported vials, private groups and offshore checkouts. That is closing fast. A $10 million Federal Court penalty in 2019. Compounding exemptions stripped from GLP-1s in 2024. Unapproved peptides now a formal TGA compliance priority in 2026.

Every one of those actions removes an operator who could never operate in the open. The lawful version of this just sold for over a billion dollars. We are building the next one, properly, from day one.

The Model Already Works

Why You

Three premierships as captain. A career built on the long game.

A club-record 188 games as Richmond captain. Premierships in 2017, 2019 and 2020.

Richmond’s CEO said you redefined leadership at the club, through self-understanding, care and connection. That is the standard the House is built on.

We are not looking for a face. We want your story and your experience, told your way.

Three Accelerators
